name: Rumble
notes: Opening: The Equalizer (R) is cast at t=0; it deploys over its stated cast delay (0.5833 s) and then ticks 18 times every 0.25 s (its 4.5 s field duration / 0.25 s tick rate), assuming the stationary target sits inside the field the whole time so the burn never lapses.

Heat: Flamespitter (Q) and Electro Harpoon (E) each generate/cost 20 Heat per cast. A cast made at 50 Heat or more (Danger Zone) has that cast's damage increased 50%. A cast that pushes Heat to 150 forces a 4 s Overheat during which Q/W/E/R cannot be cast, but basic attacks gain the passive's by-level bonus attack speed and bonus on-hit magic damage; Heat resets to 0 when Overheat ends.
Heat decays 10/s once 4 s pass without a Q/W/E cast; The Equalizer's separate 2 s decay-grace window is not modeled since R does not itself generate Heat and is only cast once in this fight.
Scrap Shield (W) is never cast: it deals no damage and its shield/move-speed effects are not modeled by the engine, so spending a cast (and Heat) on it has no measurable benefit here.

Casts go one at a time: Electro Harpoon has a 0.25 s cast time (its damage lands with the cast, then it keeps Rumble busy for 0.25 s, delaying any other cast or attack); Flamespitter has no cast time and only waits for a cast already in progress.

Flamespitter's ambiguous 'extra debuff instance on first application' is read as already included in the stated 12 ticks over its 3 s duration (the simpler of the two dossier readings), so each cast delivers exactly 12 ticks.
Flamespitter is cast whenever off cooldown and not Overheated; whether that cast is Danger-Zone-empowered is fixed at the moment of casting and applies to all 12 of that cast's ticks.

Electro Harpoon is fired with both of its assumed 2 starting charges immediately, then recast whenever a charge is available, its own 0.5 s cooldown is up, Rumble is not busy with another cast, and he is not Overheated; its stacking magic-resist shred (up to 2 stacks, further empowered in Danger Zone) is approximated with the engine's single flat shred slot, fixed at rank-5's non-empowered 18% for 4 s, refreshed on every cast.
The passive's Overheat on-hit bonus and attack speed do not apply against structures per the wiki; irrelevant here since the dummy counts as a champion.
Mana/energy are not modeled; Rumble's resource is Heat, already tracked above.

assumed.why: Rumble stocks an Electro Harpoon charge even before the ability is learned; assumed the plausible level-16 starting stock is the full 2 charges.
Fixed to Electro Harpoon's rank-5 (max, non-empowered) magic resistance reduction since the engine's shred slot accepts only one flat value and E is assumed maxed by level 16 under this maxOrder.
